description: Create a one-shot reminder/job that fires exactly once at a given absolute timestamp, then auto-deletes. Synthesizes an `exact`-kind schedule with `deleteAfterRun: true`. Pass `at` as RFC3339 (e.g. '2026-05-08T09:00:00+02:00') and a `message`.

agentId.description: Override the default agent. Defaults to gateway's default.

channel.description: Delivery channel name (e.g. 'telegram', 'email', 'discord'). Omit to keep the result internal.

deliveryMode.description: 'announce' broadcasts to channel; 'direct' DMs; 'none' keeps result internal. Defaults to 'announce' when channel is set.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

message.description: The text the agent receives at fire time. Used as the agentTurn `message` field.

timeoutSeconds.description: Hard cap for the agent run. Default 900s (15min) — enough for cold-start + non-trivial work.

to.description: Channel-specific recipient (Telegram chat id, email address, Discord channel id, …). Required when `channel` is set.

name: openclaw_cron_add_once
